description: Ask the Director to review one exact command that requires additional sandbox permission, or ask the owner to approve a declared browser form action using browser with url, origin_set, action and target. The host captures browser evidence. Use exec for ordinary sandboxed commands. For a registry or documentation download, use argv ["/usr/bin/curl", "-q", "--", "https://host/path"]. For local test sockets, list each port in needs, for example network:loopback:3000. The owner sees each requested port. On macOS these ports open on host localhost. On Linux the action gets a private localhost with no access to host services. ContextStack service ports are reserved. For a write_paths request, provide the specific absolute paths. If the action is waiting for a human decision, continue without it if possible. Repeating the exact command request during this run checks the same approval.
